spoken: to the editor, i am writing in response to your article of last thursday concerning the proposed closure of the harbour road library while i appreciate the paper's coverage, uh the piece stated that attendance had fallen by thirty percent over three years, and i believe this is incorrect according to the council's own report, which i have in front of me, the figure was thirteen percent, and it was driven almost entirely by the six months the building was shut for repairs i would also like to point out that the story did not mention the after school programme which serves around ninety children every week i would be grateful if a correction could be printed yours faithfully, adrian pell
intended: To the Editor, I am writing in response to your article of last Thursday concerning the proposed closure of the Harbour Road Library. While I appreciate the paper's coverage, the piece stated that attendance had fallen by 30% over three years, and I believe this is incorrect. According to the council's own report, which I have in front of me, the figure was 13%, and it was driven almost entirely by the six months the building was shut for repairs. I would also like to point out that the story did not mention the after school programme, which serves around 90 children every week. I would be grateful if a correction could be printed. Yours faithfully, Adrian Pell

spoken: dear members of the committee, i would like to submit my report on the first quarter of operations at the treatment plant overall performance has been within regulatory limits, with turbidity averaging point three five units against a ceiling of one there were however two unplanned outages, the first caused by a power surge on the second of february and the second by a pump failure on the nineteenth, neither of which affected supply to customers the capital budget is tracking about eight percent under forecast, mostly because the filter media replacement was delayed i recommend we approve the revised schedule at the next meeting i remain available for questions, and i thank you for your continued support respectfully, pedro vance
intended: Dear Members of the Committee, I would like to submit my report on the first quarter of operations at the treatment plant. Overall performance has been within regulatory limits, with turbidity averaging 0.35 units against a ceiling of 1. There were, however, two unplanned outages, the first caused by a power surge on the 2nd of February and the second by a pump failure on the 19th, neither of which affected supply to customers. The capital budget is tracking about 8% under forecast, mostly because the filter media replacement was delayed. I recommend we approve the revised schedule at the next meeting. I remain available for questions, and I thank you for your continued support. Respectfully, Pedro Vance

intended: This section describes how the front desk handles a guest who arrives before their room is ready. The agent should first check the housekeeping board to see whether the room is clean, because sometimes it is ready but has not yet been marked. If it is not ready, the agent offers to store luggage in the back office and gives the guest a luggage tag with a number. They should also mention the lounge, which has complimentary coffee until noon. If the guest is unhappy, and this happens more than you'd think, the agent can offer a voucher for the bar but must note it in the log. Any voucher over $20 needs a manager's sign-off. The guest should always be called, not texted, when the room is ready.

spoken: dear professor ferreira, i hope this message finds you well i am a second year phd student in the department of chemistry, and i am writing to ask if you would be willing to serve on my thesis committee my work focuses on catalysts for hydrogen production, and i believe your expertise in electrochemistry would be valuable the committee meets twice a year, in april and october, and each meeting lasts about two hours i would of course send all materials at least two weeks in advance i have attached a one page summary of my research thank you for your time and consideration sincerely, damian roth
intended: Dear Professor Ferreira, I hope this message finds you well. I am a second-year PhD student in the Department of Chemistry, and I am writing to ask if you would be willing to serve on my thesis committee. I have attached a one-page summary of my research. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Damian Roth

spoken: okay everyone, so this is the plan for the night shift handover and please actually read it when you come in at eleven you check the arrivals list first, not the messages, because the late arrivals tend to be the ones who cause trouble then you go through the room status board and flag anything that's been dirty for more than six hours um after that check the safe for the cash drawer and count it with the outgoing person, both of you sign the last thing is the wake up calls, there are usually about ten, and you set them in the system before one if you're unsure of anything, ask, don't guess, i'd much rather get a call than a mistake
intended: Okay everyone, this is the plan for the night shift handover and please actually read it. When you come in at 11, you check the arrivals list first, not the messages, because the late arrivals tend to be the ones who cause trouble. Then you go through the room status board and flag anything that's been dirty for more than 6 hours. After that, check the safe for the cash drawer and count it with the outgoing person, both of you sign. The last thing is the wake-up calls, there are usually about 10, and you set them in the system before 1. If you're unsure of anything, ask, don't guess, I'd much rather get a call than a mistake.

spoken: status update for the allotment site, the watering rota is now full through august which is a relief, zoe has taken over the compost bins and she's already turned the big heap twice, uh we lost three of the raised beds to the flooding in june and the council has promised to replace them by the end of the month, though i wouldn't hold my breath, the gate lock was changed last tuesday and everyone should have a new key by now, if you don't please tell me, the shared tool shed is a mess so we've scheduled a clear out on the sixth, bring gloves, and finally the competition for the largest marrow will be judged on the thirtieth of september, with a prize of fifty pounds, not twenty five, because the committee voted to increase it
intended: Status update for the allotment site. The watering rota is now full through August, which is a relief. Zoe has taken over the compost bins, and she's already turned the big heap twice. We lost three of the raised beds to the flooding in June, and the council has promised to replace them by the end of the month, though I wouldn't hold my breath. The gate lock was changed last Tuesday, and everyone should have a new key by now. If you don't, please tell me. The shared tool shed is a mess, so we've scheduled a clear out on the 6th. Bring gloves. And finally, the competition for the largest marrow will be judged on the 30th of September, with a prize of £50, not £25, because the committee voted to increase it.

spoken: dear dr patel, i'm writing to follow up on the staffing review for the cardiac ward, as discussed on monday, we're currently running with four vacancies on the nursing side, and two of the agency nurses have given notice, which agnes and i think is going to put us under real pressure by the end of the quarter, uh we've interviewed six candidates so far and made offers to three, one of whom has already accepted, i'd like to propose that we extend the overtime approval until the end of november, that would cost roughly eight thousand pounds a month, but it's cheaper than the agency rates, i've attached the figures, please let me know if you'd like to discuss before the board meeting on the third, kind regards, kirsten okafor
intended: Dear Dr Patel, I'm writing to follow up on the staffing review for the cardiac ward, as discussed on Monday. We're currently running with four vacancies on the nursing side, and two of the agency nurses have given notice, which Agnes and I think is going to put us under real pressure by the end of the quarter. We've interviewed six candidates so far and made offers to three, one of whom has already accepted. I'd like to propose that we extend the overtime approval until the end of November. That would cost roughly £8,000 a month, but it's cheaper than the agency rates. I've attached the figures. Please let me know if you'd like to discuss before the board meeting on the 3rd. Kind regards, Kirsten Okafor

spoken: the power went out at about four yesterday and i was alone with the kids, which was a nightmare, i w- i was prepared though, we have candles, and the camping stove, and a whole box of board games, so we made a fort in the living room, and we had soup on the stove, and played monopoly by flashlight, at some point my daughter said this is the best day ever, and i thought, wow, all it took was a blackout, the power came back at nine and everyone groaned, which i did not expect, we turned it off again for another hour, just because, my husband got home at ten and said what's going on, because the whole house was dark and we were all in a fort, i said you missed it, and he did

spoken: so basically the band broke up, it wasn't dramatic, there was no fight, we just sat in the garage after practice and nobody picked up their instruments, and finally dave said i think we're done, and everyone kind of nodded, i thought i'd be sad but i mostly felt relieved, we've been playing the same twelve songs for six years, and the bar gigs were getting depressing, but then i got home and i saw my guitar in the corner and i cried a little, um which was embarrassing because my wife was watching, she just hugged me and didn't say anything, which is why i love her, anyway i wanted you to know before it's on facebook, don't be weird about it, i'm okay, i think i just need a month before i play again, then maybe i'll start something new, something quieter

intended:
Crew rest and duty policy.

The purpose of this section is to explain how flight attendants on long-haul routes are scheduled for rest, in line with the new regulations that took effect in January.

Any duty period that exceeds 12 hours must be followed by a minimum of 10 hours of rest at the hotel, and that rest period begins when the crew member checks in, not when the aircraft lands. Exceptions can be approved by the base manager, which in practice means Antonio, but only in cases of weather disruption or aircraft recovery.

Crew members who feel too fatigued to operate should call the duty desk immediately and they will not face any penalty for doing so.

intended:
Brand voice guidelines.

Our tone should be warm and direct. We write the way a thoughtful person would talk to a friend, which means short sentences, active verbs and no jargon unless the audience uses it themselves.

When writing headlines, aim for under eight words and lead with the benefit rather than the feature. For example say save an hour a day, not automated scheduling engine.

Avoid exclamation points in client-facing copy, with one exception, the holiday campaign, where up to two per email are fine.

If you are unsure whether something fits the voice, ask Irene before it goes to the client.

intended:
How to handle a customer complaint at the service desk.

Start by listening without interrupting. Let the customer finish explaining even if you already know the answer, because people calm down faster once they feel heard.

Next, repeat the problem back in your own words and confirm that you've understood it correctly. If the issue involves a repair that went wrong, pull up the work order and check the technician's notes before you respond.

You can authorize a credit of up to $100 without approval. Anything above that goes to the service manager, and you should write down the customer's name and phone number so we can call them back within 24 hours.

You can authorise a credit of up to $100 without approval. Anything above that goes to the service manager, and you should write down the customer's name and phone number so we can call them back within 24 hours.

Each account executive is expected to submit a written summary at least three business days before the review meeting. The summary should include closed deals, the current pipeline by stage, and any risks to the forecast.

During the meeting, each executive gets 10 minutes to present followed by 5 minutes of questions. Leaders should focus on what changed since the last quarter rather than repeating information that is already in the dashboard.

Following the review, action items logged in the shared tracker and reviewed again at the next weekly pipeline call. Cash maintains the tracker and can add reviewers on request.
adjudicator.note: neither: "questions" plural inferable (B), but raw dropped "are" (A); Cash from raw

intended:
Objection handling playbook.

The three most common objections we hear are price, timing and competitors, and each one needs a different response.

For price objections, never lead with a discount.
1. Restate the value in terms of the customer's own numbers.
2. Ask what budget they had in mind.
3. Only then discuss flexibility on term length.

For timing objections, ask what would have to change for them to move forward, and write down the answer. Rafael has a short script for this that is worth reading before your next call.

intended:
Test drive procedure.

Before any test drive, the sales consultant must photocopy the customer's driver license and confirm that it is valid and not expired. The customer must also sign the liability form, which is kept in the blue folder at the front desk.

Consultants should always ride along, and the route should be one of the three approved loops, each of which is about 15 minutes. No drives are allowed after sunset or in heavy rain, and the car must have at least a quarter tank of fuel.

When the customer returns, check the vehicle for scratches, wipe down the interior and return the keys to the lockbox. Kai audits these forms every Friday, so please keep them tidy.

intended:
Dear Mr. Alvarez, I'm writing on behalf of the four tenants at unit 3B regarding the heating in our apartment. Since the cold snap began about 10 days ago, the radiators in the living room and the second bedroom have barely worked, and the apartment has been hovering around 61 degrees.

We reported this by phone on the 2nd and again on the 7th, and someone came on the 8th but left without fixing anything. We're not trying to be difficult, we simply need to know when a repair is going to happen.

intended:
Case study draft, the garden center relaunch.

Background, a regional garden center chain with 14 locations came to us in January because sales had been flat for two years and their website was hard to use on phones. They had no consistent visual identity, so every store looked slightly different.

What we did, we rebuilt the website from scratch, designed a new logo and signage system, and ran a six-week social campaign focused on locally grown plants. Antonio led the photography and the results speak for themselves.

Results, online orders rose by 140% within four months, and average basket size increased from $11 to $15.

intended: Feature request, bulk edit for opportunities. Right now sales reps have to open each opportunity one by one to change the stage or the close date, which is painful when we're cleaning up the pipeline at the end of the quarter. What we'd like is a checkbox on each row in the list view and a bulk actions menu at the top. The menu should let you change the stage, reassign the owner and update the close date for all selected rows at once. It would also be good to show a confirmation dialog that lists how many records will change. As a nice-to-have, an undo option for 30 seconds after the change would save us a lot of headaches. Tariq from the ops team estimates this would save each rep about three hours a week.
